held.company: Open a company first: a claim belongs to one company.
held.manage: Only a role that keeps the claims register can do this (compliance.claims.manage).
held.approve: Only a role that approves claims can approve (compliance.claims.approve).
held.code: Give it a code: a letter or digit, then letters, digits, ".", "_" or "-" (up to 60).
held.kind: Choose what kind of claim it is.
held.wording: Write the claim in at least one language.
held.wordingLine: A claim is one line of up to 1000 characters per language.
held.wordingRefused: The words are refused by the checker: use the wording it offers or say what is better.
held.style: Choose the style the claim covers.
held.material: Choose the material the claim covers.
held.validUntil: Give the last valid day as a date.
held.upload: Uploading a file needs the right to upload files (files.upload).
held.reasonLong: The reason is at most 500 characters.
held.noneWithdrawable: Choose claims that are not withdrawn yet.
held.replaceDraft: A draft is changed with Edit, not replaced.
held.fileGone: This file is no longer there.
held.useLabel: Choose the label it is printed on.
held.useStyle: Choose the style it appears on.
held.styleId: Choose a style of this company.
held.itemId: Choose a material of this company.
held.phraseKey: Choose a phrase of the phrase library.
held.scopeNote: Which part it covers, in up to 1000 characters.
held.note: A note of up to 2000 characters.
held.label: Name where it appears.
held.version: Someone changed it meanwhile: read it again.

use.label: Label

law.claims: From 27 September 2026 an environmental claim needs its evidence; generic claims and claims of neutrality through offsetting are not allowed.
law.GENERIC: A generic environmental claim ("eco-friendly", "green", "sustainable") is not allowed without proof of recognised excellent environmental performance.
law.OFFSETTING: Saying a product has a neutral, reduced or positive impact because emissions are offset is not allowed.
law.CERTIFIED_PRODUCT: A sustainability label must rest on a certification scheme; LWG rates tanneries, not garments.
law.NO_SHARE: Say how much: a share of which part, so the claim is not about the whole product when it is about a part.

finding.OFFSETTING: "{words}": neutrality through offsetting is not allowed: refused.
finding.CERTIFIED_PRODUCT: "{words}": LWG rates the tannery, not the garment: refused.
finding.NO_SHARE: Say how much (a percentage) and of which part.

labelCheck.ON: Label print checks every claim used on a label.
labelCheck.OFF: Label print does not check claims yet: switched off until a style or a market needs green claims (Rules & markets › Gates).
labelCheck.NONE: Label print does not check claims: no requirement for them yet (Rules & markets › Gates).

claims.search: Search code, words, style or material
claims.moreHeld: The first 500 are shown: narrow the filters.
claims.noneFilteredHint: Clear the filters to see every current claim.
claims.empty: Generic claims ("eco-friendly") are not allowed without evidence (Dir. 2024/825). Draft a claim with its words, scope, evidence and expiry.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.moves: Previous or next claim in the window

new.title: New claim
new.subtitle: A draft: it is used only once a person approves it with its evidence.
new.replaceSubtitle: When this draft is approved, the claim it replaces is withdrawn and every place it is used moves to the replacement.
new.savedWithoutFile: The draft is saved, but a file was not taken. Open the draft and add the file again (Edit).

form.choicesFailed: The styles, materials and files to choose from could not be read.
form.phraseHint: A claim phrase of the phrase library, with its approved translations.
form.scopeNoteHint: For example "the lining only": a claim about a part never reads as one about the whole product.
form.evidenceHint: The files that prove it: a certificate, a test report, a supplier declaration.
form.noEvidence: No evidence yet: a claim is approved only with at least one file.
form.fileToUpload: Uploaded when the claim is saved
form.uploadHint: PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 20 MB.
form.validHint: The last day the evidence holds; leave empty when it does not expire.
form.validSuggested: The earliest expiry of the files chosen is {date}.

approve.sentence: Approving a claim makes it usable on labels, styles, catalogues and web shop texts.
approve.whoMay: A person whose role approves claims, with a fresh code from the authenticator app
approve.note: From then on it may be used; it never changes again (a changed claim is a replacement).
approve.replacesNote: Approving it withdraws {code} and moves every place it is used to this claim.
approve.code: Approving asks for a fresh code from your authenticator app.

withdraw.usesEnd_one: It is used in {count} place: that use ends with it.
withdraw.usesEnd_other: It is used in {count} places: those uses end with it.

evidence.blocked: Its evidence no longer holds: it may not be used anywhere new.

block.FILE_GONE: An evidence file is no longer there.

where.none: Record where it appears: a label, a style, a catalogue, web shop texts.
where.noneNotApproved: A claim is used only once it is approved.
where.flagBlocked_one: Its evidence no longer holds and it is still used in {count} place: change it there.
where.flagBlocked_other: Its evidence no longer holds and it is still used in {count} places: change them.
where.flagRetired_one: It is withdrawn but still recorded in {count} place: end that use.
where.flagRetired_other: It is withdrawn but still recorded in {count} places: end those uses.

activity.label: Changes and approvals
activity.evidenceExpired: Evidence expired: flagged where it is used

saved.approved: Approved: it may be used from now on.
saved.approvedReplacing: Approved: {code} is withdrawn and {count} uses moved here.

notice.drafted: Draft {code} created: add its evidence and approve it.
notice.replacementDrafted: Replacement {code} drafted: approve it with its evidence to take over.

refusal.NOT_DRAFT: Only a draft changes or is approved; an approved claim is replaced by a new one.
refusal.NOT_APPROVED: A claim is used only once it is approved.
refusal.NO_EVIDENCE: Add at least one evidence file before approving.
refusal.EVIDENCE_NOT_AVAILABLE: Every evidence file must be uploaded and available before approving.
refusal.EVIDENCE_EXPIRED: An evidence file has expired: add a valid one first.
refusal.EVIDENCE_OTHER_COMPANY: The evidence files are files of this company that are not deleted.
refusal.VALID_UNTIL_PAST: The evidence has expired: a claim is not approved after its evidence expired.
refusal.CODE_TAKEN: This code is taken in this company: choose another.
refusal.STYLE_OTHER_COMPANY: The style is one of this company's styles.
refusal.MATERIAL_NOT_ALLOWED: The material is one of this company's materials, never a finished garment.
refusal.PHRASE_UNKNOWN: The phrase is not in the phrase library.
refusal.REPLACES_OTHER: A replacement replaces an approved or withdrawn claim of this company.
refusal.ALREADY_REPLACED: This claim has a replacement already: change or withdraw that one.
refusal.NOT_HOLDING: Its evidence no longer holds: it may not be used anywhere new until a replacement is approved.
refusal.USE_TAKEN: This claim is recorded there already.
refusal.USE_RECORD: Choose a label or style of this company.
refusal.WORDING_REFUSED: The words are refused by the checker.
refusal.DATABASE: The database refused this change: read the claim again.

problem.forbidden: Your role does not allow this.
problem.notFound: This claim is not there (or not for you).
